title_source: 우버 "딜리버리히어로 품어 100개 시장 진출...자율주행 14조원 투자"
summary_source: [지디넷코리아]우버가 딜리버리히어로 인수를 통해 사업 지역을 100개 시장으로 확대하고, 자율주행(AV)을 차세대 성장축으로 육성하기 위해 수년간 100억 달러(약 14조 2200억원)를 투자하겠다고 밝혔다. 인공지능(AI)은 단일 혁신보다 서비스 전반의 수천 가지 개선을 통해 성장 동력으로 활용하겠다는 전략도 제시했다.다라 코스로샤히 우버 최고경영자(CEO)는 5일(현지시간) 2분기 실적발표 컨퍼런스콜에서 "딜리버리히어로 인수는 우리의 사업 범위를 거의 100개 시장으로 확장하고, 모빌리티와 딜리버리를 모두 제공할 수 있는 시장 수를 거의 두 배로 늘리는 계기가 될 것"이라며 "우리의 기술과 우버원을 더 많은 이용자에게 제공함으로써 장기적으로 상당한 주주가치를 창출할 것으로 믿는다"고 말했다.우버는 딜리버리히어로 인수 이후 기술 플랫폼 통합을 최우선 과제로 추진한다. 발라지 크리슈나무르티 최고재무책임자(CFO)는 "우버는 하나의 글로벌 기술 플랫폼으로 딜리버리 사업을 운영하고 있는 반면 딜리버리히어로는 배달의민족을 제외한 대부분 사업이 하나의 별도 스택으로 운영되고 있다"면서 "이를 우버의 현대적인 기술 스택으로 통합할 수 있는 기회가 크다"고 설명했다.…

summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]ウーバーがデリバリヒーローで買収を通じて事業地域を100の市場に拡大し、自律走行(AV)を次世代成長軸に育成するために数年間100億ドル(約14兆2200億ウォン)を投資すると明らかにした。人工知能（AI）は、シングルイノベーションよりもサービス全体の数千の改善を通じて成長動力として活用するという戦略も提示した。提供できる市場数をほぼ2倍に増やすきっかけになるだろう」とし「私たちの技術とウーバーワンをより多くの利用者に提供することで長期的に相当な株主価値を創出すると信じる」と述べた。バラージ・クリシュナムルティ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「ウーバーは一つのグローバル技術プラットフォームでデリバリー事業を運営している一方、デリバリヒーローでは配達の民族を除くほとんど事業が一つの別々のスタックで運営されている」としながら「これをウーバーの現代的な技術スタックに統合する機会が大きい」と説明した。
title_en: Uber "Entering into 100 markets with Delivery Hero... Investing 14 trillion won in autonomous driving"
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Uber announced that it will expand its business area to 100 markets through the acquisition of Delivery Hero and invest $10 billion (approximately KRW 14.22 trillion) over the next few years to foster autonomous driving (AV) as the next-generation growth axis. It also presented a strategy to use artificial intelligence (AI) as a growth engine through thousands of improvements across services rather than a single innovation. Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said in a conference call announcing second quarter earnings on the 5th (local time), "The acquisition of Delivery Hero will be an opportunity to expand our business scope to nearly 100 markets and nearly double the number of markets where we can provide both mobility and delivery." “We believe that by providing Uber One to more users, we will create significant shareholder value in the long term.” Uber is pursuing technology platform integration as a top priority following the acquisition of Delivery Hero. Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Balaji Krishnamurti explained, "Uber operates its delivery business as a single global technology platform, while most of Delivery Hero's businesses, excluding Baedal Minjok, are operated as a separate stack. There is a great opportunity to integrate this into Uber's modern technology stack."

title_source: LG헬로비전, 2분기 영업익 30억원...전년비 71.7%↓
summary_source: [지디넷코리아]LG헬로비전은 2분기 연결 기준 매출 2433억원, 영업이익 30억원, 순이익 11억원을 기록했다고 6일 밝혔다.전년 동기 대비 매출은 31.3%, 영업익은 71.7% 감소했다.교육용 스마트 단말 보급사업 시장 축소와 방송통신 시장의 어려움이 반영된 것으로 보인다.사업 부문별 매출은 방송이 1198억 원, 인터넷 335억원, 알뜰폰(MVNO) 368억원을 기록했다. 렌탈은 308억원, 미디어와 B2B를 포함한 지역기반사업은 219억원을 달성했다.방송과 알뜰폰 매출은 전년 동기 대비 각각 2.7%, 9.9% 감소했다.방송은 VOD 매출 감소, 알뜰폰은 이동통신 시장 저가 요금제 경쟁이 실적 하락의 주요 원인으로 작용했다.렌탈 부문은 성수기 가전시장 경쟁이 치열해지면서 전년 동기 대비 31.7% 감소했다.김영준 LG헬로비전 상무는 “하반기에도 지속적인 경영효율화를 통해 경쟁력과 수익성 회복의 토대를 마련하겠다”고 밝혔다.
title_ja: LGハロービジョン、第2四半期営業利益30億ウォン...前年比71.7％↓
summary_ja: [GDIネットコリア] LGハロービジョンは第2四半期の連結基準売上高2433億ウォン、営業利益30億ウォン、純利益11億ウォンを記録したと6日明らかにした。事業部門別の売上高は放送が1198億ウォン、インターネット335億ウォン、アルムフォン(MVNO)368億ウォンを記録した。レンタルは308億ウォン、メディアとB2Bを含む地域基盤事業は219億ウォンを達成した。競争が激しくなり、前年同期比３１．７％減少した。キム・ヨンジュンＬＧハロービジョン常務は「下半期にも持続的な経営効率化を通じて競争力と収益性回復の土台を設ける」と明らかにした。

summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] LG Hello Vision announced on the 6th that it recorded sales of KRW 243.3 billion, operating profit of KRW 3 billion, and net profit of KRW 1.1 billion on a consolidated basis in the second quarter. Compared to the same period last year, sales decreased by 31.3% and operating profit by 71.7%. This appears to be a reflection of the shrinking market for smart terminals for education and difficulties in the broadcasting and communications market. Sales by business division were KRW 119.8 billion for broadcasting and KRW 119.8 billion for internet. It recorded 33.5 billion won, and MVNO recorded 36.8 billion won. Rental sales achieved KRW 30.8 billion, and regional business, including media and B2B, reached KRW 21.9 billion. Broadcasting and budget phone sales decreased by 2.7% and 9.9%, respectively, compared to the same period last year. For broadcasting, decreased VOD sales, and for budget phones, the competition for low-price plans in the mobile communication market was the main cause of the decline in performance. The rental sector decreased by 31.7% compared to the same period last year as competition in the home appliance market during the peak season intensified. It decreased. Kim Young-jun, managing director of LG Hello Vision, said, “We will lay the foundation for recovery of competitiveness and profitability through continuous management efficiency in the second half of the year.”

title_en: RaonSecure carries out government-promoted blockchain specialized university support project
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] RaonSecure (CEO Soonhyung Lee and Jeongah Lee), an AI security and authentication platform company, was selected as a performing company for the '2026 Blockchain Specialization University (Graduate) Support Project'. This is a project promoted by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA). It will serve as a core axis of the government-led blockchain talent training project. According to the company on the 6th, this project is to cooperate with universities and industries to operate a blockchain curriculum required in the industrial field and train professional manpower with practical capabilities. The key is to narrow the gap between university education and industrial demand by organically connecting blockchain curriculum and practice, problem-solving projects, mentoring, and corporate internships. RaonSecure will begin business in earnest starting with the signboard ceremony held on the 5th. In charge of the 'University Hub', which provides common blockchain technology infrastructure for Seoul Women's University, Konyang University, and Hansae University, it spreads blockchain technology and industry experience throughout university education. First, the company provides a joint practice environment so that students can learn blockchain technology in an environment similar to an actual service site. summary_ja: GoogleがAI組織の大々的なリーダーシップ改編を断行した。ジェフ・ディーン首席科学者の退社により、デミス・ハサビスディープマインドCEOがその場を引き継ぐことになった。代わりにディープマインドの実質的な運営は、コライカブクオーグル最高技術責任者（CTO）が引き受けながら、研究中心だった組織が製品と商用化中心に再編されるという見通しが出る。グーグルは5日（現地時間）公共になったディープマインドCEOは別途指定しなかったが、組織運営はカブク中央グルー CTOに任せると明らかにした。
title_en: Google AI leadership reorganization... Hassabis as chief scientist DeepMind focuses on commercialization
summary_en: Google has carried out a major leadership reorganization of its AI organization. Following the departure of Chief Scientist Jeff Dean, DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis will take over the position. Instead, Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Koray Cavuoglu will be in charge of DeepMind's actual operation, and there are predictions that the organization, which was focused on research, will be reorganized to focus on products and commercialization. Google announced on the 5th (local time) that Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind, will be appointed as Google Chief Scientist and Chairman of Google DeepMind. The vacant DeepMind CEO was not separately designated, but the organization's operation was announced to be left to CTO Cavucuoglu.

title_en: Kakao, second quarter sales of KRW 2 trillion and operating profit of KRW 277 billion... "Highest quarterly performance ever"
summary_en: Kakao (CEO Jeong Shin-ah) announced on the 6th that it recorded sales of KRW 2.0985 trillion and operating profit of KRW 277 billion in the second quarter of this year on a consolidated basis. Sales increased by 9% and operating profit by 36% compared to the same period last year, and both sales and operating profit are the highest ever in a quarter. Operating expenses were KRW 1.8214 trillion, a 6% increase compared to the same period last year. By business area, sales of the platform division were KRW 1.2303 trillion, an increase of 17% compared to the same period of the previous year. Among the platform division, sales of Talk Biz recorded KRW 643.2 billion, a 12% increase compared to the same period of the previous year. Among them, Talkbiz advertising and subscription sales amounted to KRW 399.9 billion, an increase of 14% compared to the same period last year.

title_en: Meta unveils coding agent 'Muse Code'... differentiated through background asynchronous
summary_en: Meta launched its terminal-based AI coding agent ‘Muse Code’ and coding-specialized model ‘Muse Spark 1.2’ as beta versions, competing head-on with Antropic and OpenAI. By leveraging the 'asynchronous background agent' structure that operates continuously, the differentiating factor is that complex software development tasks can be processed faster and more efficiently than existing AI coding tools. Meta announced on the 5th (local time) that Muse Code will provide a wide range of services from change planning to code writing, testing and verification for a large-scale code repository.
